label: matched-clean ADE >1.0 m within eligible binary population; frozen labels unchanged
feature_scope: 31 nonempty subsets of the five frozen deployment-compatible groups; token identity excluded

selection_rule.primary: highest arithmetic mean of ten pooled-OOF average precisions

search.adaptive: previously examined TRAIN scenes and prior subset results; exploratory selection

ablation.variants: selected set and every single retained-group deletion; RF on selected features
ablation.empty_representation: constant score 0.5 if one-group winner is ablated
ablation.scope: new pre-fixed partitions of same TRAIN scenes, NOT independent data confirmation

class_weight: fit negative/positive; all negatives retained; stop-fit weight computed separately

early_stopping.refit: full model-fitting subset before inner calibration; never after calibration

preprocessing: float32; nonfinite to NaN; fixed feature lists; native LightGBM missing handling

rf.imputation: fit median; keep empty features zero

bootstrap.scope: conditional on saved post-selection fold predictions; not selection-adjusted confirmation
